milestones.description: Uses position_inside_box because this is a find/locate task in a compact scene where radius-based detection would trigger from spawn. The garden area (x=3-8, z=-7 to -3) contains the oxeye_daisy at (~5,0,-5). The box defines the garden boundaries, requiring the player to physically navigate ~7 blocks from spawn to the east-north garden section.

Uses position_inside_box because this is a find/locate task. The hallway (x=-1 to 1, z=2 to 7) contains redstone_lamps at y=2 on the ceiling powered by redstone_blocks at y=3. The box requires the player to enter the hallway corridor, confirming they have navigated south from spawn into the lamp-lit passage.

Uses inventory_has because mining/breaking a sweet_berry_bush[age=3] drops 2-3 sweet_berries into the player's inventory. The player is not given sweet_berries at start, so their presence confirms the bush was mined. The bush is at (~6,0,-5) in the garden area.

Uses position_inside_box because this is a find/locate task. The birch_trapdoor storage room is at (x=-10 to -8, z=-6 to -3) in the northwest. The box extends to x=-7 to include the doorway approach area, ensuring the player has navigated to and entered the storage room.

Uses position_inside_box because this is a find/locate task. The gray_stained_glass partition wall is at z=8 (x=2-7). The box covers z=7-8 at x=1-7, where x=1 is the nearest walkable position in front of the glass blocks (x=2 at z=8 is the glass itself, which is solid). After the hallway wall fix (ends at z=7), the player can walk east from x=0 to x=1 at z≥8 to trigger this.

Uses position_inside_box because this is a find/locate task. The music room (x=-7 to -3, z=8-11) contains the note_block at (~-5,0,9). The box matches the room interior boundaries, requiring the player to enter through the doorway at (~-3,0-2,9).

Uses position_inside_box because this is a find/locate task. The vault room (x=2-7, z=9-11) contains the emerald_block at (~5,0,10). The box requires the player to physically enter the vault through the doorway at (~2,0-2,10), not just view it through the gray_stained_glass partition.

Uses inventory_has because mining chiseled_stone_bricks with the provided iron_pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no chiseled_stone_bricks, so their presence confirms successful mining from the vault walls.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a spruce_trapdoor (6 spruce_planks in 3x2 pattern, yields 2) places the item in the player's inventory. The player starts with no spruce_trapdoors. Materials are in the chest at (~-9,0,-5) behind the birch_trapdoor. Crafting table at (~0,0,1).

Uses inventory_has because crafting quartz_stairs (6 quartz_blocks in stair pattern, yields 4) places the item in the player's inventory. The player starts with no quartz_stairs. Materials are in the chest at (~-6,0,10) in the music room. Crafting table at (~0,0,1).
